description: Convert women's dress/top sizes or men's suit and shirt sizes between US, UK, EU, FR, IT, Japan and others. More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

from.description: women: us, uk, au, fr, eu (= fr), es, be, de, at, nl, it, jp, letter, bust-cm, bust-in. men-suits: us, uk, eu, de, fr, it, letter, chest-cm, chest-in. men-shirts: us, uk, eu, jp, letter, neck-cm, neck-in.

size.description: The size as written on the label or chart. Numbers take decimals, commas or fractions ("9.5", "9,5", "9½", "9 1/2", or a letter like "M").
